title: Fireback Queen
summary: Survive successive fireback waves until the queen becomes the final target.
overview: Survive successive fireback waves until the queen becomes the final target.

roles.label: Everyone
tips: Control the arriving spiderlings and regroup before advancing the next stage.

sections.title: Encounter plan
bullets: The controller begins with an untargetable queen and a proximity trigger.
Spiderling deaths advance the counter through several replacement queen stages and additional waves.
The final counter threshold replaces the last protected stage with the attackable Fireback Queen.

notes: Approval E300. Source review only; deployment, database spell lists and live balance have not been verified.
